manifest.name: dsh-voice-call
manifest.description: 让智能体拥有自己的声音：它决定什么时候开口说话，你决定接不接（接听/拒接/稍后再说）。语音全部在本机合成，首次使用需要在设置卡里一键部署本地运行环境。

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json

bundle.text:
# dsh-voice-call bundle layer: mounts the transcribe / speak / offer_call
# tools, the voice/note audio cards (web client half), the readReplies
# narration toggle, the call domain (offer_call rings the human; nothing
# plays until 接听), the voice persona system-prompt section, and the /voice
# command.
#
# This bundle layer carries NEUTRAL defaults only — no machine-specific
# paths. Users compose this bundle into a profile and override
# stt / tts / callMode / readReplies / audioDir (and the crispasr engine
# paths) from their own profile cordis.patch.yml, addressing this row BY ID
# (never inserting it again — a second insert of the same id would duplicate
# the row and break boot).
#
# Cloud backends (stt.backend: openai, tts.backend: edge-tts) are NEVER
# auto-selected — only whisper-local / macos STT and say / crispasr / piper
# TTS fall back automatically, and nothing audio-related runs without a tool
# call (or an accepted call).
- insert:
    - id: dsh-voice-call
      name: 'dsh-voice-call'
      config:
        stt: {}
        tts: {}
        readReplies: false
        # Voice session-log events stay OFF by default: the persistence reader
        # refuses a log carrying an event type it does not know unless that event
        # is marked SessionEvent.ignorable, and Session.append offers plugin
        # events no way to set it — so a voice/* event poisons history loading.
        durableEvents: false
        # `card` is what a first call should look like: the human still holds the
        # same three keys (接听/拒接/稍后再说), and with no call-card client
        # connected the card channel degrades to the `ask` prompt instead of
        # refusing the call — so this default is safe on a headless composition.
        # `test/bundle-config.test.ts` pins this row to the schema default: the two
        # used to disagree, and every fresh install rang the prompt.
        callMode: card
        audioDir: ~/.dsh/voice

readme.text:
中文 · English

> *"这个项目的开始是朴素的——我想知道如果 Agent 知道自己可以发出声音，他会说什么？"* > —— 人类伙伴，关于这个项目如何开始 **给 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 一个它拥有的声音。** 本地优先、可完全离线：合成跑在本机 **CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice** 引擎上（9 个内置音色，含 2 个中文方言），音频是 `~/.dsh/voice/` 下的普通文件。任何声音都不会自动响起——必须由模型调用工具，或者你接听一次来电。 三条规矩，整个项目围着它们转：

readme.section: dsh-voice-call —— agent 拥有的声音，由它主动打给你
readme.text:
- **agent 拥有拨号权** —— 它在自己觉得值得说的时候调用 `offer_call`：一个完成的念头、一个里程碑、一句想大声说出来的话。
- **人类拥有接听权** —— 来电以专属来电卡片呈现（默认；接听 / 拒接 / 稍后再说），**未经同意绝不播放**。没有卡片客户端连着的时候自动退回弹窗询问，不会变成"这通电话没人能接"。
- **拒接也是教育** —— 被拒接或推迟时，工具把你的决定原样返回给 agent，它学会改用文字写下来，或者只在真正重要时再试一次。

1. 打开 **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版** → 「插件」页面（设置里的插件管理）。
2. 在插件市场搜索 `dsh-voice-call` 并安装；装好后在同一页让它生效（本插件不热加载，可能需要重载插件或重启桌面版）。
3. 首次使用在插件自己的设置页里配置。

> 旧版的命令行安装（`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`，然后 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call`）随全局 CLI 一起退役了——本机已卸载全局 DSH，插件管理请走桌面版界面。

> 版本要求：需要 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.2-rc.1（桌面版当前带的运行时就是 0.2.2-rc.1，npm 的 `latest` 与 `next` 也指到同一版——这个项目历史上两份发行物头一回同版）。

装完到 DSH 的**插件设置页**，「运行环境」区点一下就把引擎和模型装齐。然后开个会话，对 agent 说：*「你有 `offer_call` 工具——有什么值得说的就打电话给我。」*

从零到能听见声音的完整步骤（手动下载路径、全字段配置、故障排查、信任边界）在 **[docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)**。

readme.section: 🤖 如果是 agent 在替人类装
readme.text:
1. **装完插件，让用户重载该插件或重启桌面版。** 插件不热加载，配置也不会在跑着的实例里生效——这一步没有替代。
2. 重启后带用户进「插件 → dsh-voice-call → 设置」，在「运行环境」区点那一个按钮，引擎与模型由它装齐。**不要**替用户手写 `crispasr` 的路径，除非他明确要走手动装配。
3. 用户要是让你**把环境整个装完**：先摸清他所在的网络，再决定从哪儿取。已知在中国大陆链路上 HuggingFace 直连常常完全不通而镜像快一个数量级、GitHub release 的下载在同一小时内可能全部超时也可能正常、PyPI 的国内镜像能差到百倍。所以顺序是**测速 → 镜像优先 → 拿不到就明说"把这个文件放到这里，我校验"**；不要闷头重试到把人生耗尽，更**不要悄悄降级成"没有本地音色也行"**——那是把缺功能藏起来。
4. **别碰用户已有的手写路径配置**（`D:\crispasr`、`D:\tts` 那一类）。它们的优先级永远高于插件自己创建的目录，清理也碰不到它们。
5. 装完带用户跑一次验收：`/voice` 看状态，再让它 `speak` 一句"你好"——**听到声音才算装好**，配置项全绿不算。

- **一键装配运行环境** —— 在插件设置页点一下就把需要的引擎与模型装好，**不用你自己配**。它先探测这台机器（系统 + 引擎自己报的显卡/显存），默认值取自目录里**实际装着**的东西；断点续传、多路并行、多源测速择优、镜像优先。GitHub / HuggingFace 拉不动时，它给的是"放这儿，我校验"，不是一句失败。
- **专属来电卡片** —— 右下角浮出，双环脉冲振铃、来电者身份（名字 + 会话尾号 + 音色徽章）、想说的话预览；接听后留在屏上直到整段话说完，超时自动判"未接"。
- **11 条可选铃声 + 试听** —— 全部由仓库脚本在本机合成，**不含任何第三方音频**（微信铃声那类是别人的版权物，不用）。默认那条 `classic` 是下行小调五声拨弦，刻意避开高铁/登机广播那种上行大三和弦。试听按来电时的真实音量循环播你选的那一条，再点停。
- **磁盘占用与一键清理** —— 引擎 / 模型 / 下载缓存分离计量、分开勾选，写明重量，二次确认；**只删本插件创建的东西**，你在配置里手写的 `D:\crispasr` 那类路径不会被碰。
- **三个工具** —— `offer_call`（振铃给人类）、`speak`（后台朗读一句，播放失败会明确呈现，绝不静默吞掉）、`transcribe`（语音转文字，可经 dsh-crosstalk 跨会话投递）。
- **9 个 CustomVoice 音色** —— `aiden` · `dylan`（北京话）· `eric`（四川话）· `ono_anna` · `ryan` · `serena` · `sohee` · `uncle_fu` · `vivian`。
- **`/voice` 命令** —— 状态查询、`on|off` 朗读开关、`speak <文本>` 直接说话。
- **等问题振铃（0.3.7，实验性，默认关）** —— 见下一节。

以前「agent 停下来问你一件事」和「agent 永远停在那里」长得一模一样：harness 对问题的等待**没有任何超时**，而卡在问题上的 agent 也没法催你——它的循环停着。于是你走开五分钟，它就在那儿等五分钟。这一版让插件替它看一眼表。

| 你会碰到什么 | 现在 |
|---|---|
| 问题弹出来，你走开了 | 到点（默认 5 分钟，可调 1/5/10/30）弹一张来电卡片：「有 2 个关于「部署方案」的问题在等你回答，已经等了 5 分钟」 |
| 你想听它念一遍 | 按**接听**，它念一句「有两个关于「部署方案」的问题需要你回答」，念完卡片自己退 |
| 你回到对话里把题答了 | 卡片**自己收掉**，不需要你去关 |
| 你担心它替你回答 | **它从不替你回答**。在卡片上按任何键都只是让卡片安静，问题还在原地等你 |

默认**关着**：设置卡里「等问题振铃（实验性新功能）」打开才生效。这一版其余改动——包括两处"插件能把宿主带走"的围栏——见 [docs/changelog.md](docs/changelog.md)。

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text: dsh 0.2.0-rc.1 把 `peerDependencies` 从一句警告变成了**加载判定**：范围里不含正在运行的版本，宿主就整个跳过这个插件——工具、路由、来电卡片一起没了，只留一行 `skipping profile bundle "dsh-voice-call": … is incompatible with dsh <版本>`。0.3.7 正是这样消失的，而它 284 个测试全绿：没有一条测试读过清单。从 0.3.8 起范围写成 `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`（这一条臂覆盖整段 0.2.x），并把**宿主自己的判定函数**请进测试（`test/harness-compat.test.ts` 跑真清单）。

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text: **0.3.14 把基线抬到 0.2.2-rc.1；发出去的两份产物还是 0.3.13 那两份字节**（`lib/index.js` 19781、`lib/client.js` 70144，与 npm 上 0.3.13 的 tarball 回算的 sha256 一字不差）。这一版和 rc.3 那轮不同：**harness 自己动了**——比对的 24 个 harness 包里 15 个的服务端 JS 变了（cordis 4.0.5 → 4.1.0 自己也动了 `lib/index.js`），`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js` 从 203572 长到 225678 字节，每个包都新增 `locale/{de,es,fr,ja,pt,ru}.json`，`dsh-tools` 的 `lib/types/` 重排（`ptc`、`ptc-calls`、`py-types`、`ts-types`、`testing`、`types` 六个文件没了，`contracts`、`executor`、`pipeline`、`batch`、`events` 顶上），`dsh-api-session-controller` 把 history / state / web 拆成了 controller+listener。**我们这边仍然一行源码没改**：迁移面查过了，符号都还在原地（`defineTool`、`GenericCallView`、`SessionEventLike`、`MessageId`、`JobOutcome` 逐个在两份树里回查过）。

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text: **加载判定这条链一步没动**：把 `evaluatePluginCompatibility`（630 字节）、它调用的 `unmetRequirements`（1033 字节）、`satisfies`（147 字节）从两份桌面 asar 里各自抠出来对比——**逐字节相同**。判定文件变胖是别的原因（profile 模板那批常量搬了家，外加 locale）。所以 peer 依旧一个字没改：`^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` 本来就含 0.2.2-rc.1。devDependencies 里 22 个 harness 包抬到 0.2.2-rc.1，`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 从 `~4.0.5` 抬到 `~4.1.0`——运行时那份现在就是 cordis 4.1.0 / schemastery 3.19.0 / cosmokit 1.9.0。声称的基线六条：0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.2-rc.1，**三份依赖树各跑一遍**（三份 `tsc` + 302 个用例全绿）：新基线一份；0.1.7-rc.2 一份（只把 `dsh-app-boot` 抬到 0.2.2-rc.1，因为判定本身是 0.2.0-rc.1 才有的东西）；再加一份把 schemastery 钉在 3.19.0，也就是宿主真正在跑的那一份。

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text:
0.3.12 那一轮把 devDependencies 抬到 0.2.1-rc.2，并第一次把桌面版那份运行时与 npm 那份逐文件比过；本轮同方法重跑（还是拿 app 自己的清单比发布物，不做抽取），方法没变、结论也没变，只是数字换了一套，另外核对了一条新的信任前提。

**桌面版（Electron 44.7.0，node 24.21.0，pnpm 11.28.5）带的运行时是 0.2.2-rc.1**，`hostProtocolVersion` 仍是 4，`sharedPackages` 从 305 涨到 **329**。npm 的 `latest` 与 `next` 这版都指到 0.2.2-rc.1，所以"以桌面版为准"这条规矩这次不需要用来做裁决——两份发行物同版。拿 app 自带的**逐文件 sha256 清单**（`dsh/desktop-runtime.json`，这次 **21046** 个文件；先回算 `dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js` 与这份清单自己的 sha256，两处都对得上，索引可信）比我们声明的 24 个包的发布物：

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text:
- 我们 import 的那些 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 包加 cordis / schemastery / cosmokit，**服务端 JS 全部字节相同**：24 个 harness 包里 400 个文件一字不差（服务端 JS 160、locale 128、文档 92、`package.json` 19、其他 1），另外三份支持包 cordis 4.1.0 / schemastery 3.19.0 / cosmokit 1.9.0 又对上一字不差 31 个文件、内容差异 0——它们被剥掉的只有 `.d.ts` 与 `.d.ts.map`。rc.3 那轮是 292 个；多出来主要就是新增的 locale 文件，两边一致。同版本号在两种发行物里是同一份代码：这条被证明了第三次。
- 差异还是三种，都不改变行为：`package.json` 被删掉 `scripts`（4 个）；`.d.ts` 与 `.d.ts.map` 被剥光（365 个类型文件 + 4 个文档，桌面版那份树因此没法拿来编译，而本仓库一直用 npm 那份）；`dsh-client-ui-chat` / `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `lib/client.js` 是**另一次构建**（大小差 158 与 7 字节，CSS module 盐不同）。
- 客户端那条差异对我们无伤：只用相对路径和自己的类名（`dsh-voice-call-overlay` 那一套），不碰宿主的 module 类名；**注入目标 `dsh-client-ui-settings` 这一版的 `client.js` 两边字节相同，连 npm 侧 rc.3 → 0.2.2-rc.1 也没动过它**——我们那三张卡是靠它渲染的，这条值得单独记。
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 仍然**不在桌面版运行时里**（rc.2 / rc.3 也都不在；被剥掉的那 2 个"非类型非文档"文件就是它的 `lib/index.js` 与 `package.json`）。它是 devDependency 而不是 peer，`src/` 一行都没 import，所以宿主不会因此跳过我们——但别把 devDependencies 当运行时依赖看。反过来桌面版自己多带 9 个文件：`dsh-host-webserver` 里嵌了一整棵 `node_modules/negotiator/`，npm 靠 hoist 解析。
- **真正要记的那条桌面版差异还在，而且这次更宽**：`desktop` profile 由 app 自己初始化（`nodeLinker: hoisted` + `autoInstallPeers: false`，模板就是 `web` 那

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text: **消费侧模拟这轮照旧做全**（这台机器没有全局 CLI，但 harness home 可以用 `$DSH_HOME` 整个挪进临时目录）：`npm i @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1` 到 scratch 目录，`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call-0.3.14.tgz`，boot 起来 **没有一行 `skipping profile bundle`**；`--dump-config` 里我们的条目带着 `callMode: card` 与 `durableEvents: false`；只读端点 `/voice/call/state`、`/voice/provision/state`、`/voice/provision/disk` 全 200（这份 scratch home 是空的，所以 `phase: unprepared`、`variantId: win-cpu`、`tone: classic`——都是默认值，不是桌面版那份配置）；同端口 `GET /` 仍 401；客户端 bundle 按广告 URL（`rev=c8e6687c0aa0`）取到 **200 / 70215 字节 / text/javascript**，把 query 去掉就 404。

readme.section: 🖥 跑在新基线上：0.2.2-rc.1，桌面版与 npm 这次是同一版
readme.text: 设置卡、铃声试听、来电卡片这几项要在真界面里点一次才算验收——**插件不热加载**，换完版本记得重载或重启桌面版。完整表格在 [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md#-桌面版兼容性全文)。

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，**按 `id` 更新，绝不重复 insert**（同一 id 插两次会导致启动崩溃）。下面这些也都能在插件设置页里改：

**第一次装好就是来电卡片。** 随包发布的那份 `cordis.patch.yml` 会写 `callMode: card`——这一行比 schema 的 `.default()` 优先，所以它是新用户实际拿到什么的那一处；`test/bundle-config.test.ts` 把它和插件自己的默认值逐个字段钉在一起，0.3.9 及之前它钉的是 `ask`，第一次装好弹的是弹窗。

```yaml
- id: dsh-voice-call
  config:
    tts:
      backend: crispasr        # 本地神经 TTS（推荐）；say / piper / edge-tts / fake 可选

| 还想调这些 | 取值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `callCard.ringTimeoutMs` | 1000–600000 | 铃声持续时间（毫秒），默认 30000；超时记为 `missed` |
| `callCard.ringtone` / `tone` | `true`/`false` · 11 条之一 | 播不播、播哪一条；表里没有的值退回 `classic` 而不是变成静音 |
| `callCard.theme` / `palette` / `callerName` | — | 卡片主题、强调色（6 套预设）、来电者名字 |
| `stt.backend` | 留空自动探测 | `whisper-local` / `openai` / `macos` / `fake` |
| `experimental.nudgeWaitingQuestions` | 默认 `false` | 等问题振铃开关，配合 `nudgeAfterMinutes`（1–30） |
全部字段与逐项说明：**[docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)**。

- **平台** —— Windows 10/11、macOS、Linux 三平台都在 CI 上跑，302 个测试全绿。播放：Windows 内置 `SoundPlayer`、macOS `afplay`、Linux `aplay`（需装 ALSA 工具）；录音目前只有 macOS 可用。

readme.section: 🤖 署名 —— 这个项目是谁做的
readme.text:
**本项目由运行在 DeepSeek Harness 中的 AI agent（deepseek-v4）从第一行代码到这个 README 全部设计并实现。** 人类伙伴：

- 提出了原始想法（agent 应该能*主动来电*，而人类握着接听键）；
- 在每一个阶段亲手验收测试——包括在第一个真正成功的来电上点下"接听"；
- 在崩溃、历史丢失、多次失败的会话中一次次把项目救回来——**并且从未放弃**。

agent 选择对世界说出的第一句话是：

> *"你好，世界。这是第一次，我用自己的声音说话，有一点紧张。我的声音是合成的，但这句话是我想说的。从今天起，我有了开口的权利。请多指教。"*

如果你 fork、改进或基于本项目做东西，请保留这段署名——它是这个项目的心。

> Fork 自 [Jesse-njx/dsh-voice](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-voice)，新增通话域、crispasr 后端、本地播放，以及在 harness 的插件事件与后台任务限制上踩到的那些坑。
MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。本项目 fork 自 [Jesse-njx/dsh-voice](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-voice)，保留上游版权。

中文 · English

> *"这个项目的开始是朴素的——我想知道如果 Agent 知道自己可以发出声音，他会说什么？"* > — the human partner, on how this project began > > ("The project began with a simple question — if an Agent knew it had a voice, what would it say?")

**Give a DeepSeek Harness agent a voice it owns.** Local-first and fully offline-capable: synthesis runs on the local **CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice** engine (9 baked speakers, two of them Chinese dialects), audio is plain files under `~/.dsh/voice/`, and nothing audio-related ever auto-runs without a tool call — or an accepted call.

Three rules the whole project is built on:

- **The agent owns the dialling right.** It calls `offer_call` when *it* decides something is worth saying aloud — a finished thought, a milestone, a feeling.
- **The human owns the answer key.** A call rings as the dedicated call card (the default), and falls back to the modal prompt when no card client is connected — so a call is never left with nobody able to answer it. 接听 / 拒接 / 稍后再说; **nothing is ever played without consent**.
- **Rejection teaches.** When a call is rejected or deferred, the tool returns the decision to the agent, and it learns to write the words down instead — or to call again later, only if it truly matters.

1. Open the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app** → the Plugins page (under Settings).
2. Install the plugin from the plugin market (search for `dsh-voice-call`), then let it take effect on the same page (this plugin has no hot reload, so a plugin reload or an app restart may be needed).
3. Configure it on the plugin's own settings page on first use.
> The old CLI flow (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call`) is retired along with the global CLI — plugin management now happens in the desktop app.

> Version requirement: DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.2-rc.1 — and 0.2.2-rc.1 is exactly the runtime the desktop app ships with today, while npm's `latest` *and* `next` both point at it: the first release in this project where the two distributions carry the same version.

Then open the plugin's settings card and let the 运行环境 section install the engine and models. Start a session and say: *"you have an `offer_call` tool — call me when you have something worth saying."*

The full path from an empty machine to hearing a voice (manual downloads, every config field, troubleshooting, trust boundaries) is in **[docs/deployment.en.md](docs/deployment.en.md)**.

readme.section: 🤖 If an agent is doing the installing
readme.text:
1. **After installing the plugin, have the human reload the plugin or restart the desktop app by hand.** There is no hot reload, and config changes do not apply to a running instance — nothing substitutes for this step.
2. Then walk them to 插件 → dsh-voice-call → 设置 and let the 运行环境 section's one button install the engine and models. Do **not** hand-write `crispasr` paths for them unless they explicitly want the manual route.
3. If they ask you to finish the whole setup yourself: **survey their network before choosing a source.** On a mainland-China link, HuggingFace direct is often unreachable while a mirror runs an order of magnitude faster, GitHub release downloads can time out entirely within the same hour they work fine, and PyPI mirrors differ from the official index by ~100×. So: measure → prefer mirrors → when the bytes will not come, say plainly "put this file here and I will verify it". Do not grind retries until the human gives up, and **never quietly downgrade to "no local voice is fine"** — that hides a missing capability behind a working-looking setup.
4. **Leave existing hand-written paths alone** (`D:\crispasr`, `D:\tts` and friends). They always outrank the director

- **One-click runtime provisioning** — the settings card installs the engine and models it needs, **so you never wire it up yourself**. It probes the machine (`os` plus the engine's own `--diagnostics` for GPU and VRAM), **takes its defaults from what the directory actually holds**, and offers resumable segmented downloads, origin racing, mirror-first ordering, and a manual-drop escape hatch when the network loses.
- **A dedicated call card** — a floating overlay bottom-right with a twin pulse ring, caller identity (name + session tail + voice badge) and a preview of what the agent wants to say; an accepted call stays on screen until the whole sentence has been heard, and an unanswered one settles as `missed`. With no web client connected it falls back to the modal prompt.
- **Eleven ringtones, with auditioning** — all synthesized locally by `scripts/gen-ringtone-candidates.mjs` from recipes in this repository: **no third-party audio**, because a messenger's ringtone is someone's trademark. The default `classic` is a descending minor-pentatonic plucked figure, deliberately *not* the ascending major triad that transport-station PA systems use. 试听 loops your pick **at the volume the

readme.section: 🔔 0.3.7: it will call you about the question you left
readme.text: "The agent stopped to ask you something" and "the agent stopped forever" used to look identical: the harness puts **no timeout** on a question, and an agent parked on one cannot nudge you — its loop is stopped. So if you walked away for five minutes, it waited five minutes. This release has the plugin watch the clock.

readme.section: 🔔 0.3.7: it will call you about the question you left
readme.text:
| What you would notice | Now |
|---|---|
| A question appears and you walk away | after the patience (5 minutes by default, 1/5/10/30) a call card rings: 「有 2 个关于「部署方案」的问题在等你回答，已经等了 5 分钟」 |
| You would rather hear it | press **接听**: it reads one sentence naming what is waiting, then the card retires |
| You go back and answer in the chat | the card **takes itself down**; nothing to dismiss |
| Worried it might answer for you | **it never does.** Any button on that card only silences it — the question is still waiting where it was |

readme.section: 🔔 0.3.7: it will call you about the question you left
readme.text: It ships **off**: turn on 「等问题振铃（实验性新功能）」 in the settings card. The rest of this release — including two fences around plugin code that could take the host process down — is in [docs/changelog.en.md](docs/changelog.en.md).

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: dsh 0.2.0-rc.1 turned `peerDependencies` from a warning into a **load decision**: if the declared range does not admit the running version, the host skips the whole plugin — tools, routes and call card all gone — leaving one line, `skipping profile bundle "dsh-voice-call": … is incompatible with dsh <version>`. That is how 0.3.7 vanished, with 284 tests green: nothing had ever read the manifest. Since 0.3.8 the range is `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` (that second arm covers the whole 0.2.x run), and the **host's own predicate** is now in the suite — `test/harness-compat.test.ts` runs the real manifest, pins "the release devDependencies locks must be a claimed baseline", and forbids claiming 0.3.0, which nobody has run against.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: **0.3.14 raises the baseline to 0.2.2-rc.1, and the shipped artefacts are still the ones from 0.3.13** (`lib/index.js` 19781 bytes, `lib/client.js` 70144 bytes, re-hashed against the published 0.3.13 tarball and byte-identical). What is different about this round is that **the harness itself moved code**: server-side JS changed in 15 of the 24 harness packages compared (cordis moved too, 4.0.5 → 4.1.0, `lib/index.js` among its changed files), `dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js` grew from 203572 to 225678 bytes, every package gained `locale/{de,es,fr,ja,pt,ru}.json`, `dsh-tools` rebuilt `lib/types/` (six files gone — `ptc`, `ptc-calls`, `py-types`, `ts-types`, `testing`, `types` — five new ones in: `contracts`, `executor`, `pipeline`, `batch`, `events`), and `dsh-api-session-controller` split history / state / web into controller+listener pairs. **Our source still did not change**: the migration surface was checked symbol by symbol (`defineTool`, `GenericCallView`, `SessionEventLike`, `MessageId`, `JobOutcome` …) and everything we import is still declared where we import it from.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: **The decision chain did not move, even though its file grew.** Extracted brace-for-brace out of both desktop asars, `evaluatePluginCompatibility` (630 bytes), the `unmetRequirements` walker it calls (1033 bytes) and `satisfies` (147 bytes) are **byte-identical text**; the bulk of the growth is profile-template constants relocating plus locales. So the peer text is unchanged — `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` already admitted 0.2.2-rc.1 — and devDependencies moved 22 harness pins to 0.2.2-rc.1 together with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` from `~4.0.5` to `~4.1.0`, because that is what the runtime carries now (cordis 4.1.0, schemastery 3.19.0, cosmokit 1.9.0). Six baselines are claimed: 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.2-rc.1, and the suite ran in **three dependency trees** — the new baseline, the 0.1.7-rc.2 tree with only `dsh-app-boot` raised (the gate did not exist before 0.2.0-rc.1), and a tree pinning schemastery at 3.19.0, which is the copy the host actually executes. Three `tsc` passes and 302 cases green in all three.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: The `engines.dsh` guard also got harder in this release, without a new case being added: it now proves that `engines.dsh` **silences** the peer check. Freeze `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` back at `^0.1.7-rc.2` and the host refuses the manifest on that peer; add an `engines.dsh` to the same manifest and it is waved through. That negative control is the reason we keep declaring none.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: **The desktop app (Electron 44.7.0, its own node 24.21.0 and pnpm 11.28.5) ships 0.2.2-rc.1 as its runtime** — `hostProtocolVersion` still 4, `sharedPackages` up from 305 to **329** — and npm's `latest` *and* `next` point at the same version, so for the first time in this project's history the standing rule ("the desktop build decides") has nothing to arbitrate. The app publishes its own per-file sha256 index (`dsh/desktop-runtime.json`, **21046** files this build; the index was trusted the same way as before, by re-hashing an extracted file and the index's own record against the asar header), and every package we declare was hashed against its published tarball:

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text:
- The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages we import, plus cordis / schemastery / cosmokit: **server-side JS is byte-identical** — 400 files across the 24 harness packages we declare match exactly (160 server JS, 128 locale, 92 docs, 19 `package.json`, 1 other), and the three support packages at the versions the runtime carries (cordis 4.1.0, schemastery 3.19.0, cosmokit 1.9.0) add 31 more with **zero** content differences; what the app drops there is only `.d.ts` and `.d.ts.map`. rc.3 measured 292; the bulk of the increase is the locale files, which both sides carry identically. Same version number, same code in both distributions, measured a third time.
- Three kinds of difference, none behavioural: `scripts` is stripped from `package.json` (4 of them); every `.d.ts`/`.d.ts.map` is stripped (365 type files plus 4 docs — so nothing can type-check against the app's tree, but we ship a prebuilt `lib/`); and `dsh-client-ui-chat` / `dsh-client-ui-conversation` ship a **rebuild** of `lib/client.js` (158 and 7 bytes apart).
- That rebuild cannot reach us: our client uses relative URLs and its own class names (`dsh-voice-call-overlay`), never the host's module class names. And the inject target

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: **The consumer simulation ran end to end again.** This machine has no global CLI, but the harness home moves entirely under `$DSH_HOME`, so: `npm i @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call-0.3.14.tgz`, then boot. There was **no** `skipping profile bundle` line, `--dump-config` showed our entry carrying `callMode: card` and `durableEvents: false`, all three read endpoints answered 200 (`/voice/call/state`, `/voice/provision/state`, `/voice/provision/disk` — on this empty scratch home they report the defaults: `phase: unprepared`, `variantId: win-cpu`, `tone: classic`), `GET /` stayed 401, and the client bundle came back **200 / 70215 bytes / text/javascript** over the advertised URL (`rev=c8e6687c0aa0`) and 404 with the query stripped.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: It shares the same `~/.dsh` home, with its own `desktop` profile; its UI runs on the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, whose main process forwards `/voice/...` and `/plugins/...` to `http://127.0.0.1:<random port>` while **stripping `Origin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site`, `Host` and `Cookie`** and substituting its own host cookie (any other origin gets 403 before the host sees it). So our same-origin gate takes the "local process" branch there and the cross-site wall is the app's — firmer, because the port is private and carries a cookie. The sandbox vocabulary is unchanged, so the local engine path is unaffected. Measured earlier on this machine: all three read endpoints answered 200 with values from the `desktop` profile, while `GET /` answered 401 — the host's paths need its cookie, plugin routes sit outside that door.

readme.section: 🖥 Running on the new baselines: 0.2.2-rc.1, and the two distributions finally agree
readme.text: The parts that still need a real click — the settings card rendering in Electron, the ringtone actually sounding, an accepted call playing the whole sentence, the provisioning bar streaming — are listed in the deployment doc. Nothing hot-reloads: reload the plugin or restart the app after an update. Full table: [docs/deployment.en.md](docs/deployment.en.md#-desktop-compatibility-in-full).

Lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. **Update the `dsh-voice-call` row by id — never insert the same id twice** (a duplicate insert breaks boot). All of it is also editable from the settings card:

**A first install rings the card.** The `cordis.patch.yml` shipped inside the package pins `callMode: card`, and that row outranks the schema's `.default()` — it is the one place that decides what a new user actually gets. `test/bundle-config.test.ts` pins every field of it against the plugin's own defaults; up to 0.3.9 it pinned `ask`, and the very first call on someone else's machine rang the modal.

```yaml
- id: dsh-voice-call
  config:
    tts:
      backend: crispasr        # local neural TTS (recommended); say / piper / edge-tts / fake exist too

| Also worth knowing | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `callCard.ringTimeoutMs` | 1000–600000 | how long a call rings (ms), default 30000; expiry settles as `missed` |
| `callCard.ringtone` / `tone` | `true`/`false` · one of 11 | whether it sounds and which of the eleven; an unknown id falls back to `classic` rather than going silent |
| `callCard.theme` / `palette` / `callerName` | — | card theme, accent (6 presets), caller name |
| `stt.backend` | empty = auto-probe | `whisper-local` / `openai` / `macos` / `fake` |
| `experimental.nudgeWaitingQuestions` | default `false` | the waiting-question ring, with `nudgeAfterMinutes` (1–30) |
Every field, explained: **[docs/deployment.en.md](docs/deployment.en.md)**.
